title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion
description: Troubleshooting elevated API errors caused by exhausted database connection pools.
diagnostic_steps: Review application logs for database timeout errors.
Check active database connections and connection pool usage.
Review recent deployments for changes to database access.
Check whether database connections are being properly disposed.
remediation_options: Consider rolling back a recent deployment if evidence identifies it as the cause.
Restart affected services only after assessing operational impact.
verification: Confirm API error rates return below the configured threshold.
Verify database connection usage returns to normal.
Monitor API latency and service health.

title: High API Error Rate
description: General investigation procedure for elevated API error rates.
diagnostic_steps: Inspect CPU, memory, database, and network metrics.
Check recent deployments and configuration changes.
remediation_options: Identify the underlying cause before taking action.
Consider rollback if the issue correlates with a faulty deployment.
Escalate to the appropriate service owner.
verification: Confirm error rate returns to an acceptable level.
Monitor the service for recurring errors.

title: Authentication Certificate Expiration
description: Troubleshooting authentication failures caused by certificate expiration.
diagnostic_steps: Check authentication logs for certificate validation failures.
remediation_options: Renew the expired certificate using the approved certificate management process.
Restart services if required by the approved procedure.
verification: Check that certificate expiration monitoring is enabled.
